theorems.name: Submission.ted_adb_support_diff_carrier_null
theorems.statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (U : Set (Amb n ℓ)) (V : RectifiableVarifold n ℓ U) (W : Set (Amb n ℓ)), IsOpen W → V.weight W < ⊤ → (∀ y ∈ V.support ∩ W, ∃ c : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ ∀ᶠ s in 𝓝[>] (0 : ℝ), ENNReal.ofReal (c * (unitBallVolume n * s ^ n)) ≤ V.weight (closedBall y s)) → (μHE[n] : Measure (Amb n ℓ)) ((V.support ∩ W) \ V.carrier) = 0
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
